resale_co.name: Certificate of Code Compliance (CCC, also called Certificate of Continued Compliance)
resale_co.issued_by: City of Newark Code Enforcement Division (Department of Engineering, Division of Enforcement and Inspections), with a Zoning review
resale_co.valid_for: 90 days from the date of issuance
requirements: Inspection for compliance with City ordinance plus a zoning review
Separate Fire Department fire safety (smoke/CO) inspection and certificate
No open building or construction permits
Only the property owner or the owner's agent can request it (buyer only for auction or sheriff sale purchases)
If violations remain, the buyer may take responsibility by notarized affidavit with the signed contract, violations report and buyer ID (corrections after closing)

fees.label: Certificate of Code Compliance, 1-2 dwelling units

resale_co.how_to_apply: Create an account on the City's one-stop portal (newarkportal.us), submit the Certificate of Code Compliance application and pay the fees; the Fire inspection can be requested and paid on the same portal (the portal adds a service fee). Review the fire checklist and close any open permits before the inspection. Certificates are released only to the seller or the seller's agent.

evidence.quote: As per City Ordinance prior to the transfer of ownership of a residential or mixed used property a code compliance certificate and a fire department certificate of must be obtained.
A Certificate of Continued Compliance (CCC) is required when selling or transferring the ownership of a residential and mixed used properties.
A CCC is good for 90 days from the date of issuance. The Fire Certificate expires after six months from the date of issuance.
Use of this one-stop portal will significantly speed up the processing time and carries an additional service fee
The certificate fee is refundable prior to the inspection. After the inspection has occurred, the fee is not refundable.
a certification that such residence conforms to the housing and zoning ordinances of the City of Newark

resale_co.notes: Fees come from the City's portal page (newarkportal.us, branded City of Newark). The code text (Title 15 housing code, application to the Director, Department of Engineering) could only be seen through search results. The portal says it carries an additional service fee but does not state the amount. Phones on the portal: Code Enforcement 973-733-3706, Fire 973-733-7495, Zoning 973-733-3714. Larger buildings pay more (3-10 units $500, and up). Rental registration and lead-safe rental inspections are separate rental programs.

requirements: Smoke alarms and carbon monoxide alarms as required by N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3 (the City's fire checklist was not found online)
Fire safety inspection by the Newark Fire Department is part of the transfer process alongside the CCC

authorities.name: Newark Fire Department, Fire Prevention
authorities.lead_time: Fire certificate expires six months after issuance. No rush tiers published on the portal.
authorities.how_to_apply: Request and pay for the Fire inspection on the City's one-stop CCC portal (newarkportal.us) together with the Certificate of Code Compliance, or contact Fire at 973-733-7495.

evidence.quote: you will be able to request and pay for the Fire Inspection as well.
Prior to scheduling your inspection be sure to review the fire checklist of items the inspector will be checking – this will save you time and re-inspection fees.
LEAID: 0714-001 Newark City ... Name: City of Newark Fire Prev ... Enf Auth. Fire Dept ... Addr: 1010 18th Av Newark NJ 07106 ... Fire Official Gwendolyn Saleem Phone (973) 733-7495

fire_cert.notes: Fire Official name and email come from the NJ DCA fire directory (survey 10/7/2025); the City portal gives only the Fire phone 973-733-7495, which matches. The portal mentions re-inspection fees but does not list them. The fire checklist referenced on the portal was not found online, so it is unknown whether Newark still asks for a fire extinguisher after P.L.2025, c.19.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: Make sure there are no open building or construction permits before the CCC inspection.

other_items.label: Zoning review
other_items.detail: A zoning review is part of the Certificate of Code Compliance (Zoning 973-733-3714).

other_items.label: Buyer affidavit for violations
other_items.detail: If violations remain, the buyer can accept responsibility with a notarized affidavit, signed contract, violations report copy and buyer ID (plus LLC/corporate formation papers if applicable).
